title: HB784 (2021-2022 Regular Session): Brady Law Regulations; five-day waiting period for the transfer or purchase of certain firearms; require

provenance.fetched_by: LegiScan bulk dataset (gun-policy Stage 5 LegiScan check); operative text read by a Sonnet fill agent from the official legis.ga.gov PDF of the version named in note (via LegiScan getBillText)

operative_text: SECTION 1 (amending O.C.G.A. 16-11-172(a)): "(a) All transfers or purchases of firearms conducted by a licensed importer, licensed manufacturer, or licensed dealer shall be subject to the NICS; provided, however, that no firearm shall be transferred or purchased by a licensed dealer until five days after such transfer or purchase has been subject to the NICS.
